title: Design System: AdvisorAI V3 Control Room

display.purpose: Overview statement only; never use for dense data.

label.purpose: Measurements, IDs, timestamps, statuses, and controls.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separate primary panels from the graphite field.

shadows.name: modal-depth
shadows.purpose: Protect a command that owns focus.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: One quiet workspace arrival; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: state-pulse
motion.purpose: Signal lamps indicate a live state without distracting from data.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A high-confidence action within the paper control plane.
components.css: .primary-button { background:#6ed9e8; color:#071014; padding:11px 14px; font:600 10px IBM Plex Mono,monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Mission Board
components.description: Fixed-column mission rows that preserve evidence and expiry in the scan path.

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A compact state label paired with a signal lamp.
components.css: .status-pill { border:1px solid #2c8061; padding:5px 7px; color:#72d3a0; font:9px IBM Plex Mono,monospace; }

narrative.overview: A quiet, dense operator instrument: fixed columns, visible state, explicit expiry, and a single authoritative safety spine. Graphite surfaces and precise rules make room for white measurement type; cyan telemetry, green approvals, amber review, and red intervention carry the state language.

rules.name: The State Has a Color Rule
rules.body: Every saturated color indicates a state, authority, or interaction.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Use tabular mono for values that must align or be compared.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Shadows only separate a floating panel or protected focus state.

donts: Do not add live activation authority to the client.
Do not hide dissent or stale data.
Do not use decorative neon or gradient text.
